lines.en: Mia, that was such a good film that I want to see it again tomorrow. Did you like the ending?
lines.pt: Mia, aquele foi um filme tão bom que quero vê-lo de novo amanhã. Você gostou do final?

lines.en: I loved it, Lena! The music was so beautiful that I cried, and I never cry in the cinema.
lines.pt: Adorei, Lena! A música era tão bonita que chorei, e eu nunca choro no cinema.

lines.en: Same here. It was such a sad story that the man next to us needed a tissue, and he looked quite tough.
lines.pt: Comigo também. Era uma história tão triste que o homem ao nosso lado precisou de um lenço, e ele parecia bem durão.

lines.en: I noticed him. The theatre was so crowded that we almost sat in separate rows, remember?
lines.pt: Eu o notei. O cinema estava tão cheio que quase sentamos em fileiras separadas, lembra?

lines.en: Yes, but we found two seats in the middle. It was such a lucky moment that I bought you popcorn to celebrate.
lines.pt: Sim, mas achamos dois lugares no meio. Foi um momento de tanta sorte que comprei pipoca para você comemorar.

lines.en: Thank you! The popcorn was so salty that I had to buy a huge soda, which cost me an extra five dollars.
lines.pt: Obrigada! A pipoca era tão salgada que tive de comprar um refrigerante enorme, o que me custou cinco dólares a mais.

lines.en: Typical! Anyway, the director made such clever choices that every scene felt important, even the quiet ones.
lines.pt: Típico! Enfim, o diretor fez escolhas tão inteligentes que cada cena parecia importante, até as silenciosas.

lines.en: Exactly. I have read that the film took so long to make that the actors grew older during the shooting.
lines.pt: Exatamente. Li que o filme demorou tanto para ser feito que os atores envelheceram durante as filmagens.

lines.en: That explains the realistic faces. It was such a moving performance that the audience clapped before the credits ended.
lines.pt: Isso explica os rostos realistas. Foi uma atuação tão comovente que a plateia aplaudiu antes de os créditos acabarem.

lines.en: I clapped too, even though I felt a bit silly. Shall we see it again on Saturday, with Carlos?
lines.pt: Eu também aplaudi, embora tenha me sentido meio boba. Que tal vê-lo de novo no sábado, com o Carlos?

lines.en: Good plan, but let us book online. Last time the line was so long that we missed the trailers.
lines.pt: Bom plano, mas vamos reservar pela internet. Da última vez a fila era tão longa que perdemos os trailers.

facts.label: Causa e consequência
facts.sub: such a good film that…, so beautiful that…, so many people that…

facts.label: such a good film
facts.sub: Use such antes de um substantivo, com ou sem adjetivo: such a good film, such good actors, such a day. Com that mostra a consequência: It was such a good film that we saw it twice.

facts.label: so beautiful that
facts.sub: Use so antes de um adjetivo ou advérbio sem substantivo: The music was so beautiful that I cried. A fila era tão longa que perdemos os trailers: The line was so long that we missed the trailers.

compare.ask: It was such a good film.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “foi um filme tão bom que vi duas vezes” e “a fila era tão longa que perdemos o começo”.
compare.tip: Diga: “It was such a good film.”
compare.us: Em inglês: It was such a good film that I saw it twice; The line was so long that we missed the start. Such combina com substantivo; so, com adjetivo.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: It was such a good film uses such before a noun.
It was so a good film is correct.
The film was so long that we left early is a natural sentence.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: It was such a good film uses such before a noun. → Verdadeiro (Yes, such a good film.)
It was so a good film is correct. → Falso (Use such a good film.)
The film was so long that we left early is a natural sentence. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Talking about a film · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Friday night in downtown Dallas. Lena and Mia leave a big cinema. The sign above the door still glows. People talk loudly about the story. Mia holds an empty box of popcorn. The two friends are still smiling.

“Mia, that was such a good film that I want to see it again tomorrow. Did you like the ending?” says Lena. “I loved it, Lena! The music was so beautiful that I cried, and I never cry in the cinema.” says Mia. “Same here. It was such a sad story that the man next to us needed a tissue, and he looked quite tough.” says Lena.
